chapter_seo_title: The Imperial Palace – Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 586 Translation
chapter_meta_description: Gao Zhijian is emperor now, but the throne holds a secret dread. Bai Lingmiao tends to an unseen Li Huowang as old comrades reunite beneath gilded shadows.
og_title: Inside the Forbidden Walls: Gao Zhijian’s Crown
og_description: A reunion in the imperial palace reveals a serene Bai Lingmiao and a locked door hiding Li Huowang. What has changed in the Son of Heaven’s court?
twitter_title: The Emperor’s Curse – Gao Zhijian’s Truth
twitter_description: Gold throne, bone-reading eunuchs, and bird’s nest porridge—nothing is safe in the Dao-Twisted World’s new royal court.

lore_anchors.definition: The eight characters of one’s birth—year, month, day, hour—used in Chinese astrology to divine fate; the eunuch’s bone-reading is a darker substitute.
The symbolic seat of imperial power in Chinese dynasties, often carved with dragons; here it represents a gilded cage and a parasitic mandate.
The classical title for the Chinese emperor, linking his rule to cosmic and celestial legitimacy; Gao Zhijian’s disinterest suggests the title is a burden, not a reward.
